rows.contract: Fragment sampling needs a retained converted R32 shadow image on devices whose writes use the atomic buffer path. StorageView currently requires texture atomics and drops the budget owner.
rows.native_mapping: Expose and implement a strong read-only R32 shadow binding independent of native texture-atomic write capability.
